layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with a yellow oval slide-number badge in the top-right corner. Directly below the title, two side-by-side definition boxes (left: Original Labels, right: Predicted Labels). Beneath them, a left-aligned vertical ladder of four statement boxes of increasing width (Objective, If/Error, Define Loss, Loss formula). A small 'Remember' reminder box floats at the right edge, vertically level with the Define box. A thin border frames the whole slide on a gray video canvas; the bottom edge of the slide is slightly cropped by the video frame.

layout.hierarchy: The title dominates (largest, bold, red/blue). The two top definition boxes are the next-largest elements. The four statement boxes form a descending left-aligned ladder, with the Define box the widest; bold red and blue keywords carry the visual weight inside them. Vector math is smaller italic serif. The Remember box is the smallest text on the slide.

visual_elements.description: Left definition box: white fill, medium red border. Content left-to-right: 'Let ' (black) + 'Y' (bold, underlined) + ' =' then a tall bracketed column vector with entries y₁, y₂, ⋮, yₙ in red italic and small red subscript 'N×1' at bottom-right of the bracket; to the right the two-line caption 'Original Labels' (red bold) / 'from Training Samples' (black regular).

Right definition box: white fill, medium red border, mirror of the left box. Content: 'Let ' + 'Ŷ' (bold, underlined) + ' =' then tall bracketed column vector with entries ŷ₁, ŷ₂, ⋮, ŷₙ in red italic and red subscript 'N×1'; caption 'Predicted Labels' (blue bold) / 'from Model Ŷ = X W' (black, with X and W bold and underlined).
Objective box: pale-yellow fill, blue border. Single line: 'Objective is' (black bold) + 'Ŷ=Y' (bold, underlined).
If/Error box: pale-yellow fill, blue border. Single line: 'If' (black bold) + 'Ŷ≠Y' (blue, bold, underlined) + '⇒' (black) + 'There is an' (black) + 'Error (Loss)' (red, bold italic).

Define box: pale-peach/orange fill, red border, widest box on the slide. Single line: 'Define' (black) + 'Loss' (red bold) + 'function as' (black) + 'squared distance' (blue) + 'between' (black) + 'Ŷ and Y' (bold, underlined).
Loss formula box: pale-yellow fill, blue border. Single line: 'Loss' (red bold italic) + '=‖Y−Ŷ‖₂ = (Y−Ŷ)ᵀ(Y−Ŷ)' in black with Y and Ŷ bold and underlined, subscript 2 and superscript T.
Remember sidebar: small pale-blue rectangle with thin blue border. Line 1: 'Remember' (red bold italic). Line 2: '‖a‖₂ = aᵀa' (blue, with a bold italic).
Slide-number badge: yellow filled oval (no visible outline) containing the black number '21'.
Small gray plus-shaped mouse cursor (screen-recording artifact, not slide content).

imagery: No photographs, icons, or illustrations. The only non-text graphics are the vector-drawn colored rectangles, the yellow oval slide-number badge, and the '+' cursor artifact.

typography_notes: Serif (Times New Roman-like) throughout, including the title. Title ~28–32pt bold; box statement text ~20–22pt; Remember box ~14–16pt. Heavy use of bold for keywords; mathematical vector/matrix symbols (Y, Ŷ, X, W) are bold with underlines; scalar/vector entries (y₁…yₙ, a) are italic. 'Error (Loss)', 'Loss' (formula box) and 'Remember' are bold italic. Two-line captions in the top boxes: first line bold and colored (red/blue), second line black regular. Only 'LOSS' in the title is all-caps. No numbered or bulleted lists — each statement sits in its own colored box.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all boxes and equations are visible with no partial reveal. A '+' mouse-cursor artifact below the Define box indicates this is a frame from a screen-recorded lecture; the slide is very slightly cropped at the bottom edge of the video frame.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to light gray #E8E8E8 and add a thin darker-gray border rectangle framing the content area. 2. Insert a centered title text box at the top: 'Concept of ' in bold red #C00000 serif, 'LOSS' in bold blue #0000CC, ' Function' in bold red #C00000 (~32pt Times New Roman). 3. Top-right corner: draw a small yellow (#FFFF00) oval with black '21' centered inside. 4. Upper-left: draw a white rectangle (~37% wide) with a 2pt red #C00000 border. Inside, use Insert > Equation to build: 'Let ' + bold underlined 'Y' + ' =' followed by a tall bracketed column vector with rows y₁, y₂, ⋮, yₙ (red italic) and red subscript 'N×1' at the bracket's bottom-right. To the right of the vector place the two-line caption: line 1 'Original Labels' (red bold), line 2 'from Training Samples' (black). 5. Upper-right: duplicate this box (~37% wide) with 'Let ' + bold underlined 'Ŷ' + ' =' and a column vector ŷ₁, ŷ₂, ⋮, ŷₙ (red italic, subscript N×1); caption line 1 'Predicted Labels' (blue #0000CC bold), line 2 'from Model Ŷ = X W' (black, X and W bold underlined). 6. Below, build a left-aligned stack of four boxes, each pale yellow #FFFFCC with 2pt blue #0000CC border except where noted: (a) 'Objective is Ŷ=Y' — 'Objective is' black bold, 'Ŷ=Y' bold underlined; (b) 'If Ŷ≠Y ⇒ There is an Error (Loss)' — 'Ŷ≠Y' blue bold underlined, 'Error (Loss)' red bold italic; (c) widest box, fill pale peach #FCE4D6 with red #C00000 border: 'Define Loss function as squared distance between Ŷ and Y' — 'Loss' red bold, 'squared distance' blue, 'Ŷ and Y' bold underlined; (d) 'Loss=‖Y−Ŷ‖₂ = (Y−Ŷ)ᵀ(Y−Ŷ)' — 'Loss' red bold italic, Y and Ŷ bold underlined, built with the Equation editor for the norm bars, subscript 2 and superscript T. 7. Right side, level with box (c): small rectangle filled #D6EAF8 with thin blue border containing 'Remember' (red bold italic) over '‖a‖₂ = aᵀa' (blue). 8. Use Times New Roman for all text; ~20–22pt in boxes, ~14–16pt in the Remember box. 9. Do not add the gray '+' cursor — it is a recording artifact, not slide content.
